title: YLX measurement data selection v1
description: Immutable, unrevisioned planned-action input selecting one closed side of an exact data partition for one measurement evidence action. The selected group, source-digest, and sample sets are recomputed from the exact partition. An evidence-producing PASS execution evaluation must bind this artifact under the measurement_data_selection prerequisite kind; the later evidence, threshold, and queue wrappers cannot self-assert a different partition membership. This payload grants no authority and is neither evidence nor a verdict.

selection_id.description: One-shot immutable identity. A retry or changed partition/group set uses a new selection_id.

source_group_ids.description: Every ID resolves exactly once in data_partition_ref.source_groups and has partition_side equal to this selection's side.

selected_group_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON UTF-8 for the lexicographically sorted unique source_group_ids array.

selected_source_digest_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON UTF-8 for the lexicographically sorted unique union of source_digests from the selected source groups.

selected_sample_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of ASCII rows sample_id TAB sample_kind TAB sample_sha256 LF, sorted lexicographically by the full tuple and deduplicated, for every expanded sample in the selected source groups.

publication_readback_schema.description: The payload does not embed its own raw-byte digest. Procedural validation selects exactly one external readback by artifact_schema, selection_id, and raw-byte digest, and requires a digest-derived locator and exact-byte readback.

authority_effect.description: The selection is a planned-action input only. It creates no evidence, threshold, verdict, execution authorization, milestone status, or release authority.

dataPartitionRef.description: The current immutable data-partition v1 family has implicit artifact revision 1.
